lastScan.description: Aggregates of the most recent scan as JSON: overall score, finding count, per-check ratios and a timestamp. Never issue content or personal names.

ignoredChecks.description: JSON array of check IDs an administrator marked as intentional.

ignoredItems.description: JSON array of {check, item}: single objects an administrator marked as intentional. The item is configuration of the instance - a project key, a board id, a field or group name - never an account and never issue content.

lastRun.description: The findings of the most recent scan as JSON, so that reopening the report does not require another scan: per check its status, ratio, headline, evidence and the configuration objects it named - project keys, board ids, field and group names. Never issue content, and never an account: the accounts the licence check names are counted and not stored.

scanHistory.description: JSON array of the last 24 scan aggregates, newest first, for the score trend. Same aggregates as lastScan: numbers and timestamps only.

scanStarted.description: ISO 8601 instant when a scan was last started, so that a second widget can say a scan is already under way instead of asking the instance everything twice. A timestamp, nothing about the instance itself.
